Overview
The research degree programmes aim to train and produce graduates with an understanding of advanced developments and highly marketable specialist skills in the field of neuroscience. Graduates of this programme will meet international standards with regard to their knowledge, technical expertise and communication skills, both written and oral. So prepared, graduates will be highly competitive for professional positions in the academic, commercial, and technical sectors where demand for well-trained neuroscientists is steadily increasing.
Research Degree Coordinator: Prof. Youngjin Lee
